name: Chamartín (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Chamartín (a bear on blue above a mount).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 18 January 2002 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 36 of 20 February 2002); the flag is rectangular of proportion 1:2, red, with the municipal arms in its tinctures and colours at the centre.

features.role: Chamartín arms — bear on blue above a mount
